description: Source code for generating help and documentation for Playwright CLI commands, including functions for command argument parsing, help text generation, and command categorization.

methods.name: commandArgs
methods.description: Extracts command arguments and their descriptions from a command schema.

methods.name: commandArgsText
methods.description: Formats command arguments into a string for help display.

methods.name: generateCommandHelp
methods.description: Generates detailed help text for a specific command.

methods.name: generateHelp
methods.description: Generates the overall CLI help text, categorized by command groups.

methods.name: generateReadme
methods.description: Generates a markdown-formatted README section listing commands.

methods.name: generateHelpEntry
methods.description: Creates a single help entry line for a command.

methods.name: generateReadmeEntry
methods.description: Creates a markdown list entry for a command in README.

methods.name: generateHelpJSON
methods.description: Creates a JSON object containing help information, including global help, commands, and boolean options.

methods.name: formatWithGap
methods.description: Formats a string with padding to align help text.
